name: Strawberry

schedule.notes: Plant crowns AT soil line — buried crowns rot, exposed roots dry. Pinch flowers year 1 for stronger plants.
Compost top-dress in spring; again after fruiting.
June-bearers: 3-week burst in early summer. Everbearers: smaller picks all season.

harvest.cues: Fully red, slight give, comes off the cap with a gentle twist. Pick early morning for best flavor.
harvest.storageNotes: Fridge unwashed 3 to 5 days. Freeze whole on a tray, then bag — best for smoothies, jam.

varieties.name: Honeoye
varieties.notes: Large early berries. Reliable in cold climates.

varieties.name: Albion
varieties.notes: Crops all summer. Firm, transports well, classic 'store' shape.

varieties.name: Alpine
varieties.notes: Tiny intensely fragrant berries. No runners — comes true from seed. Edges, borders, containers.

notes: Renew the patch every 3 to 4 years — yields drop. Mulch with straw to keep fruit clean and slow gray mold. Cover with bird netting at first blush.
